lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters organized in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill region; prominent 4-blob vertical alignment visible in the central flank transition zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like configuration across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature along the upper lateral flank, characterized by a highlight on the superior edge and a shadow-driven gradient on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-to-moderate density of high-luminance blobs observed within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily located along the leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transition in spot morphology from large, discrete clusters on the mid-flank to high-density, reduced-diameter spots on the cranial and pectoral regions.
